93: I completed it -- he is a paid bailee - and we do not say that the bailee is exempt since the owners knew that the term of the contract had expired and yet they did not send for and retrieve [the finished item]. Likewise regarding a borrower, even though the owners knew that the term of the loan had expired, he [would remain in the status of] a borrower.
No -  you should [not] deduce that if he said "I completed it" he would be a paid bailee; rather, the following is what you should deduce from it:
Give money - since he reveals that he insists upon his remuneration, he is [considered] a paid bailee.
